semanticConstraints: This scope covers the exact selected Host WithConfigurationProvider and WithWebRouting integration, not every CShells public option type or feature's private settings.

CShells:SharedAssemblies is read as indexed scalar patterns by CShellsBuilderExtensions.WithConfigurationProvider. SharedAssemblySelector rejects blank selectors and wildcard positions other than a final '*'; selectors target assembly simple names.

CShells:Shells is a map keyed by nonempty trimmed shell identity. ConfigurationShellBlueprintProvider rejects keys parsed by Int32.TryParse as unsupported array syntax; its case-insensitive dictionary overwrites normalization collisions rather than independently rejecting them. ShellConfig.Name is not a separately bound Host identity.

ConfigurationShellBlueprint.ComposeAsync loads Configuration first, then Features. Feature settings flatten below the feature name and replace matching Configuration prefixes. ShellSettingsExtensions caches a separate in-memory configuration root for each composed settings snapshot.

ConfigurationHelper accepts feature-name strings and Name-bearing objects in legacy arrays, or a map of feature names to true/false/direct setting objects. Feature names are trimmed and unique case-insensitively; mixed numeric/named keys and invalid scalar/wrapper shapes are rejected. true resets inherited feature settings; false removes the feature and its settings; an empty direct object preserves existing settings.

Web routing keys are resolved from each shell's WebRouting settings. Host resolver strategy options are code-configured, not JSON-bound. Only an explicitly empty WebRouting.Path selects an unprefixed fallback shell; unmatched unowned routes retain the native Host status response.

The configuration blueprint rereads its selected section on composition. Existing active-shell settings are a snapshot; changing these Host files does not automatically rebuild an active shell. Restart or an explicit native generation lifecycle operation is required. Package directory watching is distinct from settings reload.

Configuration may contain selected feature settings and secret references; their own setting contracts must supply value constraints. This integration contract does not export application secret values or claim feature-owned settings coverage.

bindings.binding: Manual native WithConfigurationProvider section readers; CShellsOptions is a source shape, not a wholesale ConfigurationBinder target.

SharedAssemblies.description: Assembly simple-name selectors used for feature discovery; exact names or final-star prefixes.

Shells.description: Named shell blueprints. Each map key owns the shell identity; native Int32-parsable array keys are rejected.

constraints.mapKey: nonempty trimmed shell name not parsed by native Int32.TryParse; normalized names use case-insensitive dictionary identity

bindings.binding: ConfigurationShellBlueprint calls ConfigurationHelper.LoadConfigurationFromSection, ParseFeaturesFromConfiguration and ApplyFeatureEntries; no wholesale ShellConfig binder.

Features.description: Feature selection with preferred object-map or supported legacy-array protocol.

Configuration.description: Shell-local hierarchical values flattened into a new settings snapshot. Selected features own their detailed value contracts.

bindings.binding: Native ShellRouteIndexBuilder, DefaultShellRouteIndex and ShellEndpointRegistrationHandler read WebRouting keys from the shell settings snapshot.

Path.description: Shell path identifier; explicitly empty selects root fallback. Native path index admission and endpoint prefix normalization are distinct.

RoutePrefix.description: Native endpoint registration trims '/' at the edges and combines this prefix with the shell Path.

Host.description: Host-name match used by the native enabled host-routing strategy.

HeaderName.description: Optional shell-local header routing declaration; resolver strategy selection remains Host code.

ClaimKey.description: Optional shell-local claim routing declaration; resolver strategy selection remains Host code.

native Setup translations after bound dedicated options
Host directory-feed and Loading module configuration callbacks
semanticConstraints: This scope covers the eight Nuplane sections bound by this exact Host AddNuplane callback; it does not claim every Nuplane module's public configuration API.

NuplaneOptionsRegistrationServices binds Setup, Reconciliation, FeedResolution, LockFile, CleanupPolicy, Convergence and StoreRegistry using ConfigurationBinder; LoadingRegistrationServices binds Loading through the Host AutoloadPackages(configuration) overload with enableByDefault false. Native validators run on options start without this metadata producer initializing services.

NuplaneSetupConfigurationServices translates AutomaticReconciliation through NuplaneBuilder.PollEvery, overriding dedicated reconciliation enablement and poll interval only when enabled. Nonblank Setup.StateFilePath overrides StoreRegistry.StateFilePath. Setup.UseInMemoryStore true overrides its dedicated flag. Native validators reject conflicting in-memory/file modes.

NuplaneFeedSetupDeclarationReader supports indexed feed declarations and named-map declarations. Named keys supply Name and must agree with an explicit Name; a named declaration wins over a legacy array declaration of the same case-insensitive name with a warning. Duplicate named declarations and source-shape errors are rejected by the owning validator.

Setup feed declarations select exactly one nonblank directory path or absolute service index. Directory settings are translated by the separately selected Directory module; remote feed names/endpoints are translated through native builder registrations. Setup include patterns are nonblank and deduplicated case-insensitively before translation.

NuplaneSetupOptionsValidator, ReconciliationOptionsValidator, FeedResolutionOptionsValidator, FeedCredentialOptionsValidator, ConvergenceOptionsValidator, LockFileOptionsValidator, CleanupPolicyOptionsValidator, StoreRegistryOptionsValidator and LoadingOptionsValidator are retained exact source authorities for range, relationship, URI, credential-reference and uniqueness constraints. Metadata structural shape supplements those semantic checks; it does not invent missing enum/range rejection in native validators.

LoadingOptionsValidator requires positive deactivation timeout and defined load-mode enums; override IDs must be nonblank, trim-stable and unique case-insensitively. Shared identities require nonblank Name, a 16-hex-character PublicKeyToken, nonnegative MajorVersion and unique composite identity. SharedAssemblyIdentity constructor fields have no implicit element defaults.

The selected native ConfigurationBinder silently omits a SharedAssemblies collection entry when a required constructor token is null/missing. Empty or malformed tokens bind an entry and are then rejected by LoadingOptionsValidator. Null samples are not evidence of accepted unsigned shared identities.

FeedCredentialOptionsValidator accepts remote feeds only with HTTPS and uses secrets:// credential references; file feeds cannot contain credentials. Secret values are not metadata defaults. The source validator supplies exact policy-dependent cross-setting behavior.

Default writable paths are computed by native runtime owners from AppContext.BaseDirectory; this producer emits the source option's null/default literal rather than an environment-specific resolved path. EffectiveStorePersistenceSettings.Resolve establishes the persisted store path and in-memory behavior.

Nuplane options are configured snapshots; these native registrations do not install an IOptionsMonitor reload contract. Changing Host configuration requires restart for these options. Directory Watch/Debounce controls package-feed reconciliation, not configuration-file reload.

bindings.binding: NuplaneOptionsRegistrationServices.Configure<ReconciliationOptions>; later Setup translations may override named fields.
NuplaneOptionsRegistrationServices.Configure<FeedResolutionOptions>; native Setup feed builders append selected feed registrations.

SharedAssemblies.description: Native host-sharing identities. Missing required record constructor fields may omit an entry during native binding; admitted entries are validated.

bindings.binding: NuplaneFeedSetupDeclarationReader binds each named/indexed setup feed; a named map key supplies Name.

Credentials.description: Credential reference consumed by the native feed credential policy; actual secret values are excluded.

Name.description: Legacy indexed entries use Name; named entries derive it from the containing key and reject an explicit mismatch.

bindings.binding: Nested NuplaneFeedSetupOptions.Directory is bound then translated by the Host-selected Directory module.
ConfigurationBinder positional record element binding; required constructor fields must be present for an element to bind.

Credentials.description: Optional native credential reference; no secret value/default is exported.

bindings.binding: ConfigurationBinder positional record binding followed by LoadingOptionsValidator. A missing/null required constructor parameter silently omits the collection entry.
ConfigurationBinder native collection item binding followed by LoadingOptionsValidator.
